meta.name: Portfolio Snapshot + One Pager data dictionary (verified content)
meta.verification: Every formula and source verified against live code (one_pager.py, metrics.py, portfolio_snapshot_*.py, config.py) on 2026-09-24.
meta.audience: analysts — internal table/column/account names are fine to show
meta.granularity: one entry per (tab, field); each entry decomposes into `inputs`, each with its own source.
meta.formula_rule: Render `formula_latex` when present (formula_is_arithmetic=true). When null, the field has NO clean single-expression arithmetic — state the method in words and DO NOT reconstruct an equation. Never invent a formula or a source.

answer_format.latex: block math on ONE line as $$...$$ ; inline as \( ... \) ; never ** inside a formula

fields.formula: funded_to_date = Σ (−Amt) over non-OP, non-commitment rows where MajorType~'contrib'

fields.definition: Capital returned to the PE investor.
fields.formula: return_of_capital = Σ Amt over non-OP rows where MajorType~'distri' AND TypeName~'return of capital' OR 'realized gain'

inputs.note: 'realized gain' IS included here but NOT in the cap-stack equity netting — the divergence that breaks the balance subtraction below.

NOT funded_to_date − return_of_capital: that subtraction is contaminated by realized-gain rows (East Manchester gives −1,539,662 vs the engine's 0). Falls back to the subtraction only if full_data is absent.
Overridden to 0.0 when committed_pe==0 and the partner_results contribution fallback fires.

fields.definition: Return on equity to date (annualised, time-weighted — NOT IRR).
fields.formula: roe_to_date = Σ(distributions, inception→quarter-end) ÷ weighted-avg capital ÷ years

inputs.source: MRI — accounting_feed.Amt, non-OP, EffectiveDate <= quarter-end, InvestmentID->vcode

inputs.source: Calc — Σ(balance × days) ÷ total_days; balance floored per step at max(0, prior + change)

inputs.source: Look-forward window: pref distributions (TypeID 1019 or name ~ 'preferred/pref return'), non-OP, non-commitment, in (quarter-end, +45d] pulled back to quarter-end

fields.definition: Underwritten ROE to date (same calc on underwritten flows).
